setlist_extra.title: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **wharf rat** (3 reviews): Huge thunderclap and lightning bolt behind the stage during Wharf Rat; the PA cut out briefly, and Phil answered with bass; In Wharf Rat, a lightning bolt struck and Phil answered instantly with a bass bomb [15][21][25]
- **sugar magnolia** (2 reviews): Weir goes wild in Sugar Magnolia, rapping about dreamtime and ending with banshee-like wails; Second set is legendary for its Sugar Magnolia [14][19]
- **little red rooster** (1 review): Reviewer names Little Red Rooster among the best versions [25]
- Reviewer ranks Music Never Stopped and Sugar Magnolia among the best versions, alongside the Baby Blue encore [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **little star**: rare: 3 archived performances [26]
- **it's all now baby blue**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-06-20.119816.aud.chasingwilma.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 165 min [1]
- **gd1983-06-20.163432.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 169 min [2]
- **gd83-06-20.fob-senn.sws.11931.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 167 min; rated 4.26/5 by 35 [4]. Said about its sound: Post-drums portion of the source sounds tinny and slightly distorted; the rest of the show sounds fine; Reviewer finds the audience recording's sound pretty good for an audience tape [14][22]
- **gd1983-06-20.fob.minor.vernon.83762.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 176 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Tape flip after My Brother Esau; shnid 11931 drums source has a clipped left channel [5]
- **gd1983-06-20.148016.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [6]

## Around the show

- Rain poured through most of the show; the listener sat on the lawn and kept dry smokes [15]
- Mud slide formed down the hill toward the pavilion; parking lots flooded and water ran under the pavilion seats [16]
- Heavy downpour wrecked freshly laid sod and left the crowd muddy; reviewer had come from a Saratoga show [17]
- Reviewer believes this was the first show played at Merriweather [17]
- Crowd cheers came from big lightning across the sky; lightning strikes briefly shorted out the power [19]
- Lightning light show synced with the music; freshly laid sod washed away into a muddy slide hill [20]
- Crowd had to cross flash-flood rapids to reach the parking lot; no one known to be hurt [20]
- Reviewer's first show; they had three seats in row C at the gate [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-06-20.119816.aud.chasingwilma.flac24**: taped by chasingwilma; transferred by chasingwilma; source: source: (3) audio technica atm11> d-5; conversion: sony tc we435> soundcard> cdwave 44100/stereo/24 bit> traders little helper encoding option 8 [1]
- **gd1983-06-20.163432.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics (18th row, center) > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [2]. Also: Master recording from Chris Hecht, transferred by Charlie Miller; patched with an AKG D330BT and Sennheiser 421 blend source; Blend source supplies the crowd and opening China Cat notes, plus the end of the Truckin' jam and Drums [2]
- **gd83-06-20.fob-senn.sws.11931.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1 and Set 2 up to Drums is: FOB-Sennheiser 421>MasterCass>Dat>CD [4]. Also: Reviewer taped the show with poor microphones and offers to check the tape for posting [16]
- **gd1983-06-20.fob.minor.vernon.83762.sbeok.flac16**: taped by David Minor; transferred by David Minor and Matt Vernon; source: fob about the 12th row ctr. or so with a sony 939lt stereo - single point mic > d6 [5]. Also: Patched from other sources, including 12 seconds in Truckin' and most of Drums from shnid 11931 [5]
- **gd1983-06-20.148016.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Hecht master recording, transferred by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones; Sony 939LT source (shnid 83762) from David Minor and Matt Vernon supplies crowd, China Cat opening and a pre-drums Jam patch [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bobbie Bestic Grateful Dead: [1983-06-21 Merriweather Post Pavilion, Columbia, MD, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-06-21-merriweather-post-pavilion-columbia-md-usa/) [27]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1983-06-20 Mon Merriweather Post Pavilion, Columbia, MD](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1274709013053/grateful-dead-1983-06-20-mon) [28]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1983-06-20 Mon Merriweather Post Pavilion, Columbia, MD](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1274709013053/grateful-dead-1983-06-20-mon) [29]
